queries.name: usuários ativos hoje
queries.sql: select count(*) from usuarios where visto_em > now() - interval '1 day'

queries.name: projetos
queries.sql: select id, nome, paineis from projetos order by id

queries.name: sessões por agente
queries.sql: select agente, count(*) as sessoes from sessoes group by agente order by 2 desc

queries.name: pedidos com erro
queries.sql: select id, status, erro from pedidos where status = 'erro' limit 20

queries.name: tokens por dia
queries.sql: select date(criado_em) as dia, sum(tokens) from turnos group by 1 order by 1

queries.name: maiores tabelas
queries.sql: select relname, pg_size_pretty(pg_total_relation_size(relid)) from pg_stat_user_tables order by 2 desc

queries.name: deploys da semana
queries.sql: select servico, count(*) as deploys from deploys where criado_em > now() - interval '7 days' group by 1

queries.name: locks abertos
queries.sql: select pid, relation::regclass, mode from pg_locks where not granted
